name: hcapp_authenticateWebPortal
description: Records a device-authenticated QR code scan for web portal login. The access token is validated against DeviceSecret concatenated with the scan data, making the token single-use per scanData value. On success, inserts a row into HC.WebPortalAuthenticationRequests (idempotent — only inserts if that scanData is not already recorded).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID. Used to look up the user and device credentials.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret + scanData concatenation — binds the token to the specific scan event.

parameters.name: scanData
parameters.description: QR code scan data from the web portal login page. Also used as the second factor in token validation.

rowsets.name: NullUserError
rowsets.description: Returned when no Device record is found for the given deviceId (userId lookup returns NULL). Non-standard error format.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 fails. Non-standard error format.

rowsets.name: SuccessResult
rowsets.description: Returned on success after the WebPortalAuthenticationRequests record is created.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.WebPortalAuthenticationRequests (hasherId, scanData) — only if no existing row with that scanData exists (idempotent)

codeSmells.issue: Non-standard error format across all error paths
codeSmells.detail: All error rowsets use Pascal-cased column names (ErrorType, ErrorTitle, ErrorDescription) with no errorId or errorProc. Inconsistent with all other app SPs that use the standard camelCase format.

codeSmells.issue: errorType=2 for null userId — wrong code
codeSmells.detail: A missing device record (userId resolves to NULL) returns errorType=2 ('Validation error'). This is really an auth/not-found case, so errorType=3 would be more accurate.
No error handling. Duplicate scanData insert is guarded by the COUNT check but not by a transaction.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
